Tides are rising faster along the coast

By Grace Writer and Lin Reporter

Gauges installed along the harbour wall in 1990 show the mean high tide climbing by four millimetres a year over the last decade, nearly twice the rate of the decade before.

The study, published on Friday, compared the harbour gauges with satellite altimetry and found the two records agree to within a millimetre a year.
